name: Haruka
source:
"...Burn."

A taciturn member of the Blooms who completes missions with effectiveness. She's been best friends with Kaori since childhood.

Her unique ability is Flame Dust, and she shows no mercy to anyone she considers an enemy.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/paradox/characters/]official website[/url]]
